questions.solution_text:
The distance travelled is the area under the velocity–time graph.
$\int_{0}^{3}\left(3t^{2}+2\right)dt$
$=\left[t^{3}+2t\right]_{0}^{3}$
$=27+6$
$=33\text{ m}$

questions.solution_text:
The volume added is the area under the rate–time graph.
$\int_{0}^{6}(15+4t)\,dt$
$=\left[15t+2t^{2}\right]_{0}^{6}$
$=90+72$
$=162\text{ L}$

questions.solution_text:
$\int_{-4}^{4}\left(x^{2}-16\right)dx$
$=\left[\frac{x^{3}}{3}-16x\right]_{-4}^{4}$
$=\left(\frac{64}{3}-64\right)-\left(-\frac{64}{3}+64\right)$
$=-\frac{128}{3}-\frac{128}{3}$
$=-\frac{256}{3}$
The cross-sectional area is $\frac{256}{3}\text{ m}^{2}$.
$V=\frac{256}{3}\times 9$
$=768\text{ m}^{3}$
